title: Without the Jargon: When You're Not Watching
markdown:
C-Suite doesn't wait to be asked. It runs on its own rhythm and reaches out when something is worth your time.

A normal day, without you starting a single conversation:

- **Morning brief.** Once a day, on your preferred channel — the state of each department and what needs your attention.
- **End-of-day digest.** Each evening — what landed, what's still outstanding.
- **Department check-ins.** Each team gets a check-in on its own cadence — weekly, monthly — and the result is posted back to the team.
- **Nudges.** If you promised someone a reply by Friday and it's gone quiet, it reminds you. Stalled commitments don't slip.
- **Inbound watch.** It watches email, Slack, Discord, and Telegram for anything material and routes it to the right specialist before it ever reaches your desk.

Nothing here happens in a black box: every proactive action is recorded and visible, and anything sensitive is surfaced to you rather than sent on your behalf.

*See also: Scheduler & Cadences for the runner and timing.*
